about: BN5's GyroSoul (Team ProtoMan's Soul 2) in both engines: its flag entry written in BN5's ROM copy and set (souls5), the Souls installed in BN6's engine holding it (souls6 bit 19), a deck of AirShot * in both (BN5's 4, BN6's 4: Wind, GyroSoul's kind), the first Custom screen's first chip picked and given up, UNITE and OK; it unites as the first turn starts (his propeller, BN5's companion overlay of kind 2, spawned as he enters; Air and Float shoes as he unites, BN5's 0x08011BDC), the Custom screens opened by L count its turns down, and it ends as the turn after its last starts (the propeller let go as he leaves). CanGard V1 at (6,2), MegaMan at (2,2) with 2000 HP, kept from harm (docs/game/team-protoman.md, unit 8).
